newNarrative.evidence: Each constituent: exact chain + address, covered launchpad, and token metadata or an official source describing the shared mechanism or story. The story: at least one independent public source (official page or X post) beyond token metadata.
newNarrative.daily: Every run evaluates every theme cluster discover.py reports and records a decision in curation.clusterDecisions (created, assigned, rejected or deferred, with a reason). Create a narrative whenever a cluster or a story meets this bar. maxActive caps how many narratives are collected and featured, not how many exist: at the cap, pause the weakest (curation.pausedNarratives) only when the new one has more 24h volume and its story is current. A paused narrative keeps its memberships and pages; it is not retired.

addMember.evidence: Same evidence bar as a new narrative constituent.

removeMember.evidence: Below the threshold on two consecutive observations: archive the coin (curation.archivedMembers) — collection stops, the membership interval stays open and the coin's pages stay reachable. Evidence that contradicts membership (for example removal from an official registry): curation.removedMembers closes the interval. Never delete the record.

retireNarrative.evidence: Below the threshold on two consecutive observations: pause collection (curation.pausedNarratives); memberships stay open. Retire (curation.retiredNarratives, closes memberships) only when the defining source is gone or contradicted. Record the reason either way.

quarantine.evidence: Flagged tokens are never constituents; record them as quarantined candidates.

storyChecks.note: discover.py stories writes the cluster theme searches (up to 10); remaining budget is for targeted follow-ups. Each X search is about 7 credits; each page scrape about 5.
